proof_body:
by
  intro f T hT hf hp
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuous_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have huc := (isCompact_Icc (a := -T) (b := 2 * T)).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hf.continuousOn
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at huc
  obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, h0⟩ := huc ε hε
  refine ⟨min δ0 T, lt_min hδ0 hT, fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
  have h3 : dist x y < δ0 := hxy.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have h4 : |x - y| < T := by
    have h := hxy.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at h
  obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := abs_lt.1 h4
  have hper : Function.Periodic f T := hp
  have h7 := (le_div_iff₀ hT).1 (Int.floor_le (x / T))
  have h8 := (div_lt_iff₀ hT).1 (Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / T))
  have h9 : (⌊x / T⌋ + 1 : ℝ) * T = ⌊x / T⌋ * T + T := by ring
  have hu : x - ⌊x / T⌋ * T ∈ Set.Icc (-T) (2 * T) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hv : y - ⌊x / T⌋ * T ∈ Set.Icc (-T) (2 * T) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hd : dist (x - ⌊x / T⌋ * T) (y - ⌊x / T⌋ * T) < δ0 := by
    rw [dist_sub_right]
    exact h3
  have h10 := h0 _ hu _ hv hd
  rwa [hper.sub_int_mul_eq, hper.sub_int_mul_eq] at h10
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℝ), 0 < T → Continuous f → (∀ x, f (x + T) = f x) → UniformContinuous f
